description: Ministry of Justice - Notify the amendment Order to the Schedule of the Gaz.Ex.No. 1679/40 of 10.11.2010 that Published under the Judicature Act
reasoning: This gazette content involves an amendment to the judicial structure under the Judicature Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It modifies the Schedule of a previous Order (published in earlier Gazettes) regarding judicial zones, districts, divisions, and their areas of jurisdiction. This falls under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory) as it deals with legal amendments and regulatory frameworks for judicial administration, not government personnel changes or specialized categories like land or commercial matters.
